dedupe_keys.name: critical infrastructure ransomware attacks cira dataset

description: The CIRA dataset lists ransomware attacks on critical infrastructure worldwide: version 12.16 holds 2,291 records of publicly disclosed incidents from November 2013 to 31 December 2025, compiled from media and security reports and mapped to the MITRE ATT&CK framework. It is maintained since September 2019 by the CARE Lab at Temple University, led by Aunshul Rege, for research, education and threat intelligence; the lab reports 1,806 requests fulfilled. Coverage is global across critical infrastructure sectors, one row per incident. Format and access: a spreadsheet sent on request through the web page, only to institutional email addresses, within two to four weeks. Licence: a limited free licence for non-commercial use with a required citation; commercial products are excluded. Caveats: only publicly disclosed incidents are included, so it undercounts and is biased to reported cases, and details such as downtime vary by source. It supports cyber-attack scenario building, cascading failure and resilience analysis, for example estimating service outage durations. A related catalogue record is SMICI, a dataset of multi-domain incidents against critical infrastructure.
